tenderSchedule.title: Government Ayurveda Hospital in Athani, a hospital signage board is to be installed near the National Highway. A 20x30 room including a toilet is to be constructed within the hospital premises. The entire electrical system and wiring of the hospital are to be upgraded, and a concrete staircase is to be installed to provide access to the roof of the hospital building. All interior doors and walls are to be renovated and painted. Push-pull type doors are to be installed for the hospital rooms.
